query:
SELECT
                AVG(value)::float8    AS "mean_24h: f64",
                STDDEV(value)::float8 AS "stddev_24h: f64",
                MIN(value)::float8    AS "min_24h: f64",
                MAX(value)::float8    AS "max_24h: f64",
                COUNT(*)::int4        AS "count_24h: i32"
            FROM readings
            WHERE sensor_id = $1
              AND created_at >= $2
              AND created_at <= $3
